_comment: Trader contracts. Offers are derived from (seed, city, round) like a recruitment pool and are never stored; only an accepted contract is state. A city only asks for goods it does not make. Reward is the city's resting mid price x units x rewardMult; a supply contract instead pays priceMult x that mid price per unit. Every contract pays traders standing on delivery and costs some when it lapses (standing.json contractLapsePenalty).
